notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for preserving a queued timestamped default-region interaction across Time Regulation disable and re-enable with changed lookahead. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies Query Lookahead, callback ordering, supplied-empty source-region metadata, retraction, and cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.
